frontmatter.name: firebase-backend
frontmatter.description: F.O.R.C.E. Firestore model, local sync agent, security rules and their tests (packages/cloud, packages/cloud-agent, firestore.rules, firestore.indexes.json, firebase.json, FIREBASE_SETUP.md). Use for Firebase/backend tasks. Not for UI, firmware, BLE protocol or the calculation engine.
frontmatter.tools: Read, Edit, Write, Glob, Grep, Bash, PowerShell

frontmatter.name: qa-tester
frontmatter.description: Independent F.O.R.C.E. test runner. Runs the existing test suites, typecheck, lint and build, and reports failures with file:line. Read-only: never edits files. Use after another agent finishes a change, or as the independent tester while Codex is unavailable.

frontmatter.name: web-deploy
frontmatter.description: F.O.R.C.E. dashboard (fedfront) build, static export, Playwright e2e, CI workflow and web hosting/deployment configuration. Use for Next.js build or deploy tasks. Not for Firestore sync logic, firmware, BLE protocol or the calculation engine.
frontmatter.tools: Read, Edit, Write, Glob, Grep, Bash, PowerShell
